name: Response Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of the received collateral message (collateral claim, a collateral proposal or a proposal/request for collateral substitution) from a collateral management perspective.

ACCP.name: Partly Accepted
ACCP.definition: Part of the collateral is accepted, a part rejected.

ACCT.name: Accepted
ACCT.definition: Claim, substitution, proposal is fully accepted.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Claim, substitution, proposal is fully rejected.

SUBR.name: Substitution Accepted
SUBR.definition: Party A agrees with the return part of the substitution and accepts to wait for the proposal of the new collateral.
